Maya (Support): Escalating Weatherly trial tenant weatherly-trial-3. Bulk docs ingest causing embed timeouts and broken demos. Customer says they'll pause the pilot if not resolved within 48h. @Ken can CS take point? :warning:
Ken (CSM): Taking this. Maya, paste any console alerts and note whether they changed client configs recently. Keep the first customer-facing comm concise.
Maya (Support): Console snippet below and they mentioned enabling parallelUploads=16 in their ingestion tool yesterday.

```
2026-09-21T02:11:07Z ERROR embed-service tenant=weatherly-trial-3 rate=980/s limit=500/s quota_exceeded
2026-09-21T02:11:09Z ERROR client sdk timeout request_id=rw-44f1
```
\nMaya (Support): We also see brief spikes that correlate with their nightly bulk window.
Priya (CS): Risk: stalled activation -> missed demos -> renewal pressure. Proposed ops+comms plan: 1) immediate acknowledgement + short ETA, 2) schedule 30m triage with eng in next 4h, 3) temporary throughput uplift to cover upcoming demo windows, 4) offer a short enablement (batching + pacing) and a sandbox key for demo traffic, 5) capture product feedback on SDK defaults and trial quota visibility. Ken, can you own external comms and the product feedback ticket?
Ken (CSM): Yes. Draft customer note (short, customer-friendly):

"Hi Weatherly team  thanks for flagging. We're seeing throttling during your recent ingest which is impacting demos. We've scheduled a troubleshooting session with our engineers in the next few hours and will temporarily increase your embed throughput for your demo windows while we stabilize. We'll also run a short enablement on batching and provide a sandbox token you can use for demos. Meeting invite coming shortly.  Ken, CSM"

Al (Engineer): Preliminary analysis: their client concurrency surged and exhausted per-tenant burst credits; embed pool in us-east-1 is operating near capacity during nightly jobs. Short-term mitigation options: (A) raise soft_limit to 1200/s for targeted demo windows and enable request smoothing, or (B) apply a temporary per-tenant burst allowance for 24h while we monitor. I'll prepare runbook steps and monitoring queries. Mid-term: recommend SDK default change (lower parallelUploads), SDK telemetry to auto-detect spikes, and an autoscale tweak for embed workers.
Maya (Support): Customer replied in the support ticket: "We have a big investor demo tomorrow, can you confirm uplift now?"
Ken (CSM): Let's avoid running changes without the triage call unless it's urgent. But given demo risk, propose: schedule triage in 1h; if customer confirms they need immediate uplift for a demo within 2h, we do a targeted uplift for the demo window only. Also offer sandbox token so demos don't hit production quotas.
revops-bot: [meeting] Created incident-weatherly-1809990000 at 2026-09-21T03:00:00Z; attendees: Ken, Al, Maya, Priya
Al (Engineer): Uplift preview (will run only with verbal OK):

```
# preview - do not run until on-call confirms
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.internal/api/tenants/weatherly-trial-3/quota \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>" \
  -d '{"soft_limit":1200, "note":"temporary uplift for demo window"}'
# post-change: GET /metrics?tenant=weatherly-trial-3&window=5m
```

Al (Engineer): Rollback plan: revert soft_limit to 500/s after the demo window or after 24h if no long-term commit. I'll post the exact CLI on the call and monitor qps, 5xxs, and latency.
Priya (CS): Action items: - Ken: send customer ack + sandbox token offer (please keep infra details out of first message). - Al: prepare uplift command, dashboard, and rollback steps. - Maya: capture the exact SDK flags they changed and upload failed request traces to the ticket. - Priya: prep AE/RevOps note in case mitigation goes beyond 24h.
Ken (CSM): Sending ack now and scheduling the 30m troubleshooting session. I'll include the demo sandbox offer in the message.
Maya (Support): Customer responded: "Thanks, please schedule and we prefer the uplift if it will be quick."
Priya (CS): I'll open a renewal-watch ticket if we go past 24h and prep an AE outreach template that offers a demo concierge session or a goodwill credit. Also capturing sentiment changes in account health.
Ken (CSM): Note for product feedback: I'll file two items after the call: (1) lower SDK parallelUploads default for trial tenants, (2) surface trial quota nearing alerts in the console with clearer guidance. Will attach any customer quotes.
Al (Engineer): On the call I'll run a live trace and if we agree, I'll apply the targeted uplift for the demo window and keep a close eye on metrics.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. After resolution I will update the account health playbook and add the RCA, the enablement recording, and the prevention checklist to the account record. :thumbsup:
Maya (Support): -- end thread --"
